title: In situ reduced gold nanoparticles in PDMS contact lenses for color blindness management
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12765-12772
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08879D, Paper
Open Access

M. Aravind, Haider Butt, Sajan Daniel George
Plasmonic contact lenses filter problematic wavelengths, enhancing color perception for individuals with deuteranopia and protanopia. Combining imaging and vision simulation, lenses are proved to be an effective solution for improved color vision.
